text:
olivia_cs: Cerulean Health just ran into APAC edge throttles during a cross-region demo. Asking for a temporary multi-region allowlist + peering + burst QPS window. Renewal due in 5 weeks; they're nervous about the demo outcome. Can ops/infra help?
max_ops: We can support but need exact regions + IPs. Are they asking for one region or multi-region failover?
ravi_net: Customer prefers primary in tokyo (ap-northeast-1) with singapore (ap-southeast-1) as failover. Provided host ranges: 150.238.10.0/28 (primary) and 150.238.20.0/28 (failover). Also two NAT egress IPs to whitelist: 150.238.10.7 and 150.238.20.9.
olivia_cs: Customer note: "we expect spikes up to 700 rps for a 90m demo; want soft=3500 qps across APAC, permit cross-region peering for failover, and a pre-approved cost cap of $120 for the demo window."
max_ops: Proposed: soft APAC aggregate=3500, per-region hard=4200, autorevoke @36h, 24h pre-revoke notice. Need eng-infra approval for peering+ACL+route pin. Also need finance sign-off on $120 cap.
finance-bot: finance-bot: noted. Will pre-approve up to $120 and provide a simple token-cost estimate to share with customer after demo.
ravi_net: Action checklist for eng-infra: 1) add CIDRs 150.238.10.0/28 and 150.238.20.0/28 to tenant allowlist 2) add NAT IPs 150.238.10.7/32 and 150.238.20.9/32 to edge ACL 3) enable cross-region peering tokyo <-> singapore for tenant cerulean-health 4) set soft qps=3500 aggregate, hard qps per region=4200 5) schedule autorevoke @36h 6) smoke test from both NAT IPs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: change draft: 2025-11-03T15:00:00Z  status: pending-approval. Summary: multi-cidr allowlist + cross-region peering + qps bump + autorevoke=36h. Ticket: ENGOPS-7432.
max_ops: ENGOPS-7432 opened and linked to @eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/ENGOPS-7432
hana_renewals: Flagging renewals and sales-ops. Demo outcome will feed the renewal playbook; I'll capture qualitative notes and escalate if demo feedback is negative.
olivia_cs: Customer asked for an email confirmation and a one-paragraph note for their execs about safety controls (rollback plan + cost cap). Can someone own that?
ravi_net: I'll draft confirmation with the validation snippet. Test curl to validate ACL after deploy:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Forwarded-For: 150.238.10.7" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck
```
Expect: 200
max_ops: Rollback triggers: sustained p50 latency > 550ms OR error rate > 2% -> revert peering/limits and notify CS + customer immediately. Also collect traces and token counts during window.
finance-bot: Will send cost snapshot after window and notify olivia_cs.
olivia_cs: Great. Please post live status updates here. If approvals block the demo, escalate to eng-infra pager and ping me. :thumbsup:
